attempts.summary: Built a minimal 'inventory' application on node2 (systemd unit inventory.service, enabled) that emits events to syslog under the local0 facility. Configured rsyslog on node2 (/etc/rsyslog.d/10-inventory-forward.conf) to forward local0.* messages via TCP to node1 with a disk-backed queue for reliability, and rsyslog on node1 (/etc/rsyslog.d/10-inventory-receiver.conf) with imtcp on port 514 to filter node2's local0 traffic into /var/log/inventory/node2.log. Verified live end-to-end delivery, then ran the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes: captured baseline boot_id/service state, issued native reboot, polled until reachable, proved boot_id changed, and confirmed rsyslog (both nodes) and inventory.service (node2) auto-recovered via systemd enablement with logs continuing to append into the same persistent file with no gaps or loss.
